project.shortDescription: Template 1.5.0 · MSC-129 Done · targets accepted · Pages branch and manuals · shared usage
project.readme:
# MyScoutee Template

[MSC-129](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap/issues/168) is **Done**: monolith, KVM and VMware accepted; shared CI/CD, the template access manual, permanent Pages branch and document loading alignment are complete. Source baseline remains 1.5.0.

Shared MSC-129: **337,935,588 tokens**, **15.062277 active / 15.062277 allocated hours**, **2,774 unique responses**, **$426.03 frozen Standard API equivalent**, through `2026-10-26T15:05:40Z`.

This is the same task allocated once in the [canonical MyScoutee ledger](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap/tree/master/guides/statistics/myscoutee).

Earlier releases and accepted tasks remain recorded below in the Project.

items.title: MSC-122: Extract reusable UI components and a generic MyScoutee template
items.body:
Delivered **MyScoutee Template 1.4.0** and **MyScoutee Components 1.4.0** on October 12, 2026.

- [x] Separate reusable components and generic application foundations from product-specific domains.
- [x] Keep MyScoutee consuming the same component owners and preserve its qualified behavior.
- [x] Qualify local/HTTP login, consent, profiles, SmartList, chat and retained operator/admin capabilities.
- [x] Qualify monolith/KVM, packaging, signed updates, recovery and publication.
- [x] Install the exact published template DEB on VMware and complete the two-member login/SmartList/chat/logout smoke.
- [x] Publish branded PDF manuals, GitHub Pages and the components npm package.

[Template and documentation](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-template) · [Live demo](https://fssrepository.github.io/myscoutee-template-frontend/) · [Template 1.4.0](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-template/releases/tag/v1.4.0) · [Components 1.4.0](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-components/releases/tag/v1.4.0)

**Checklist: 33/33 tasks and 118/118 subtasks DONE.** Git history, roadmap/account usage and heatmap are updated. The [Template Project](https://github.com/users/fssrepository/projects/6) connects both template repositories. The LinkedIn article, short sharing post and branded cover are committed in the private backend guides. General MyScoutee feature-QA campaigns remain separate.

The HTTP operator OAuth/login return now uses the existing common entry completion flow. Normal media/job configuration persists in canonical seeds and upgrade migration; test actors/faults were removed. Browser evidence, focused native checks and local/HTTP/KVM variants apply only to the scopes recorded in the existing [regression evidence](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-template/blob/master/guides/qa/evidence/general/MSC115-TEMPLATE-REGRESSION.json). Original October 12 delivery: 1,134,112,133; regression increment: 170,212,864. Corrections, reverted attempts and failure/recovery are included. Full API equivalent is unavailable; $1,576.71 is a frozen known-rate subtotal only. Both Projects show the same shared task; usage is counted once. items.title: MSC-123: Qualify VM and Netcup deployment with required security and dependency fixes
items.body:
Prepare and qualify the deployment on VMware and Netcup, including verified security/dependency fixes.

Execution order and observed status (2026-10-17):
1. [x] Resolve the 15 reported frontend CodeQL alerts (#36–50). [Verification run](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee/actions/runs/39018412934): success; no open alerts in the recorded scan. Focused regressions retained.
2. [x] Assess and apply verified dependency updates, including Firebase and Playwright, in the main application and template.
3. [x] Complete the agreed VMware/device five-point scope: registration/login and Work/Community invitations accepted by the user; actual Firebase/Android push, warmed cache/offline/reconnect and native PWA Back/guide/menu/background/reopen passed. Repair verified installer data, invitation, profile-ID, session/cache and worker-update defects. [Evidence](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-backend/blob/v1.4.1/guides/qa/checklists/group/MSC-115_LIVE_DEPLOYMENT_QA.md).
4. [x] Upgrade production Netcup to the exact signed 1.4.1 Debian release. Complete data/configuration backup verified. Package-owned migrations and host qualification PASS; all nine containers healthy, 13/13 public HTTPS checks and isolated read-only Angular render PASS. Retained production document IDs, media and existing secrets/TLS keys verified. [Deployment evidence](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-backend/blob/v1.4.1/guides/qualification/evidence/NETCUP_1.4.1_20261017.json).
5. [x] Publish [MyScoutee 1.4.1](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee/releases/tag/v1.4.1). The owner uploaded the exact signed DEB; all nine asset identities agree. Canonical public release discovery, downloaded signed catalog/manifest/key and the actual DEB URL passed. Seven images and all six artifact preflight gates PASS. The temporary untagged label was removed after binding the release to v1.4.1. The main candidate retains its prior VMware scope; no new VMware main-candidate reinstall or rollback drill is claimed.
6. [x] Port every shared MSC-123 fix applicable to retained template functions: Firebase network/session preservation, real-profile cache identity, PWA activation, consent identity, editor/badge layout and selected worker index bootstrap. Template 137/137 focused tests, 68-index parity, full actual-DEB audit, signatures, five-image publication and exact signed candidate VMware install passed. Seven healthy services, 13 TLS-enabled external checks and the two-member login/SmartList/chat/reload/logout UI smoke passed. [Template 1.4.1](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-template/releases/tag/v1.4.1) is published with all nine matching assets. Owner DEB upload verified; public signed metadata, artifact signatures, catalog signature, canonical discovery and the actual DEB URL PASS. No KVM/monolith replay.
7. [x] Publish [Components 1.4.1](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-components/releases/tag/v1.4.1) to GitHub Packages. 9/9 focused tests and library build passed; registry download is byte-identical to the released tarball. Consolidated source commits and v1.4.1 tags are pushed.

## Measured effort

**347,361,510 tokens**, **5.688961 active / 5.688961 allocated hours**, **1,662 unique responses**, through `2026-10-17T14:40:04.051000+00:00`. Reproduce with `measure-msc123.py --cutoff 2026-10-17T14:40:04.051000+00:00` in the [measurement ledger](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap/tree/master/guides/statistics/myscoutee).

Includes implementation, VMware repairs, failed/reverted attempts, corrections, real-device QA, consolidation, app/template signed release preparation, Components registry publication and requested template VMware install/UI smoke, canonical app/template publication verification and the requested production Netcup 1.4.1 upgrade/verification through the cutoff. Explicit windows exclude preceding template QA/accounting and its separate closeout. Response IDs are deduplicated and concurrent root intervals unioned; tool waits count, idle gaps do not. Shared repository work is counted once. Later accounting/publication writes are excluded. Cached input is within input and reasoning within output. Full API valuation is unavailable because the existing frozen ledger has no gpt-6.1-sol rate; no rate is invented.

MSC-123 is Done; all seven ordered steps are complete. The upgrade does not claim an independent rollback, power-loss or sustained-load drill. Commits use the `[MSC-123]` prefix and the consolidated `v1.4.1` source tags. [Release artifacts and limits](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-backend/blob/v1.4.1/guides/releases/v1.4.1.md).

items.title: MSC-126: Reduce initial loading and release MyScoutee 1.4.5
items.body:
The prioritized MSC-126 delivery batch is complete and released as **1.4.5**.

- HTTP/local constructor cache and feature loading groups preserve the existing mode selector. HTTP startup excludes local services/seeds; standalone startup excludes HTTP services. Main has 82 application chunks plus the worker, with two startup files; template HTTP has 31 chunks.
- Preferred browser language starts directly. HTTP startup requests no local EN/HU catalog and uses backend/cache data. Full version equality controls catalog refresh. Reviewed UI captions use semantic keys; user content and canonical values keep their identities.
- Owned article/room media uses direct WebP URLs through the existing numbered migration runner. Main 024/025 handle pinned key renames and the two intentionally blocked/deleted demo profiles; template 019 independently handles its own applicable keys. Normal upload variants and retained originals preserve their prior contract.
- Both mobile setup popups select the existing fullscreen behavior. Roboto 400/500 remain unchanged at the owner's request.
- Five repositories have one consolidated MSC-126 source commit each after the prior numbered task, with coordinated `v1.4.5` tags and GitHub releases. Five GHCR images and Components 1.4.5 are published with immutable digests/integrity verified. Standalone artifacts include each project's own base path and profile.
- Netcup runs 1.4.5: **13/13 public checks**, all nine containers healthy, all 82 served JS hashes and four 9,174-message catalogs verified. Seven production user documents and all indexes are unchanged. Media 947→971: 25 additions, one exact old room PNG removed, no changes to other existing objects; all 17 originals retained. VMware also verified; its three HTTP-listener checks skip through the custom HTTPS tunnel. Installed DEBs remain 1.4.1.
- Fresh independent HU mobile profiles on both hosts: one navigation per cold/warm run, no local EN/HU requests, no EN→HU heading switch and no JS errors. Focused frontend/backend/grouping/input/migration checks passed. No full frontend suite rerun, matched Lighthouse score claim, new template-host install, full new DEB qualification or rollback/power-loss drill.

items.title: MSC-128: Deliver shared 1.5.0 fixes, signed releases and Netcup deployment
items.body:
Completed **24–25 October 2026**, closed on the owner's confirmation. Main and template **1.5.0** releases are published, with consolidated MSC-128 source commits and matching tags. The release task is complete.

## Delivered

- Restored granular Components loading and consolidated shared sources; corrected startup, selected-language content, loading indicators, Guide/Setup behavior, profile/location handling, icon/font caching and gateway IP-ban behavior. Applicable fixes are included in both applications.
- Corrected encrypted account persistence, account/demo boundaries, login/logout and obsolete Base class mappings. CodeQL alerts 54 and 55 are fixed. Main backend standard suite: **2009/2009**; template: **440/440**; session regressions: **33/33 in each frontend**. Published Packaging verifier regressions: **11/11 with each application's configuration**.
- Published main/template production images, signed full DEBs, client tools, standalone archives and GitHub Pages. The template release has **14 verified assets**, including the corrected embedded client-tools archive. Shared packages remain at **1.5.0**.
- Netcup runs the exact final main DEB: host qualification passed, **9 healthy containers**, **7 matching managed-image fingerprints**, **13/13 public checks**. The template's earlier signed candidate passed VMware host qualification; the final packaging-only replacement was published with verified signatures and payload identities. The owner explicitly did not require another VMware installation of the final rebuild.

items.title: MSC-129: Reproducible MyScoutee CI/CD laboratory
items.body:
Completed 25–26 October 2026; the owner accepted the final template VMware result and requested documentation and closure.

## Delivered

- Reproducible Docker GitLab CE, myscoutee group, 22 project declarations, isolated validation and native build runners with four parallel build slots. Public defaults and project config/ci mappings are versioned; credentials remain in ignored files owned by the appropriate repository.
- Feature → master branching and manual integrated release branch/tag/publication/MR/PR flow. Normal builds and released-dependency consumer builds are automatic; tests, heavy packaging, infrastructure, deployment, release and Pages retain their explicit manual controls.
- Registry-first infrastructure preparation, reusable Terraform module with independent product state/configuration, separate domain images and unchanged-image reuse, GitLab Kubernetes agent/environment integration, scoped host setup and retention maintenance.
- GitHub Actions conversion is included but inactive under config/ci/github-actions.yml and was not separately executed. The frontend Pages workflows were removed when publication switched to the permanent branch source.
- The automatic frontend build prepares production and Pages output. Manual `deploy:github` commits ignored `docs/` to permanent `gh-pages/docs` without another clone and requests a Pages build. MyScoutee, Template and e-kozig Pages were verified against the published branch; generated docs are absent from master.
- The shared document viewer centers consent/help/terms loading in both frontends; the Template lazy consent indicator is centered too. Both frontend Pages builds passed.
- Source/package baseline remains 1.5.0; corrected shared dependency packages and locks are aligned. Trial release publications were withdrawn. One consolidated [MSC-129] commit per participating repository is synchronized to GitHub and GitLab.

## Accepted template qualification

| Target | Pipeline / jobs | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Monolith | 563; deploy 2210, verify 2215 | 14 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped; operator accepted |
| KVM | 567; package 2228, infra 2231, deploy 2232, verify 2237, agent retry 2241 | 10 public checks passed; all four domain images reused; operator accepted |
| VMware | 571; deploy 2253, verify 2258 | 11 passed, 0 failed, 3 HTTP checks skipped for the custom HTTPS tunnel; operator accepted |

Targets ran sequentially. Template VMware is left available at https://localhost:18445; monolith and KVM guests are stopped with data retained. SonarQube pipeline 488 / release job 2159 exercised the integrated release path; backend pipeline 489 / job 2165 exercised DEB packaging. No new backend/DEB rerun, Netcup deployment, full optional-test sweep or GitHub Actions runtime qualification is claimed.

## Documentation and repository closure

- [Backend access manual](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-backend/blob/master/guides/publication/manuals/MyScoutee_Laboratory_Access_Manual_EN.pdf)
- [Template access manual](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-template/blob/master/guides/publication/manuals/MyScoutee_Laboratory_Access_Manual_EN.pdf)
- [CI/CD branching and configuration manual](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-ci/blob/master/guides/publication/manuals/MyScoutee_CICD_Manual_EN.pdf)

All include the inactive Actions conversion. Editable sources/generators and logos are versioned; PDFs were visually checked. No PDF is copied to a frontend. CI references use guides/development/ci, not a parallel docs directory.

Full workspace audit includes the 25 owned repositories and their frontend checkouts; external Lean dependency checkouts are read-only. Owned source repositories have synchronized master branches and no unmerged feature/backup branches or local-only source commits; the three published frontend sites retain permanent gh-pages branches. At the owner's explicit request, the obsolete backend/frontend v1.4.2 tags and matching GitHub releases were removed; no untagged release remains. Existing application data and other releases are retained.

[Detailed qualification](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-ci/blob/master/guides/development/ci/verification.md) · [Completed plan](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-ci/blob/master/guides/development/ci/MSC-129-plan.md)
